g.text: OFFICIAL AI-FIRST ARCHITECTURAL MASTER BLUEPRINT (A4 SPEC)
Zero-VDOM • Zero-WebView • 67M ops/sec SISO • Universal Memory Registers & Slot Modulation
📦 BLOCK 1: LANGUAGE & AST PARSER ENGINE [3 FILES]
Input: Raw JSX/DSL string ➔ Tokenizes 'reg', '::', tags, braces, strings in O(N)
Pure AST node specifications: ProgramNode, RegisterDeclarationNode, JSXElement
Parses 'reg form:: name, email, password;' & JSX into clean semantic AST tree
Zero Babel, Zero npm dependencies • Sub-millisecond execution
Translates AST elements, rx/tx bindings & Tailwind styles into 24-byte layout IR
Emits binary headers, string table, component offsets into single '.dolp' file
Runs full Lexer ➔ Parser ➔ Compiler ➔ Emitter pipeline in 22 milliseconds!
Bundle Size: ~2.9 KB • Packed with 557 Vector Icon glyphs
🌐 BLOCK 3: TITAN-BUS SOVEREIGN PROTOCOL & AV CODEC HIGHWAY [4 CORE MODULES]
1. 6-Byte SISO Frame: [0x53, 0x49, REG_HI, REG_LO, VAL_HI, VAL_LO] ➔ Zero-allocation direct register read/write
2. 12-Byte AV Packet: [frameId:2B, codecType(0x14/0x15):1B, chunkIdx:1B, totalChunks:1B, flags:1B, width:2B, height:2B, payLen:2B] + payload
💻 BLOCK 4: DEV SERVER, TERMINAL QR & OTA HUB [3 FILES]
• UDP Auto-Discovery :9092 (Broadcasts offers; phones connect automatically)
• FileWatcher: Compiles & pushes new bundle to devices in < 25 ms
• ANSI ▀ and ▄ half-block character encoding with white quiet margin
• Mobile phone cameras scan PC terminal directly in under 0.1 seconds
• Initiates instant initial push upon server ready
When any .jsx file changes: Watcher debounces (200ms) ➔ buildBundle() generates 2.9KB
➔ TCP broadcast(0x01) ➔ Android BinaryParser replaces view in RAM in 2.1 ms
The user never restarts the app, never loses state, never waits for Gradle!
• Deserializes 24-byte structs directly into pure Android Views (FrameLayout, TextView)
• Zero WebView, Zero Reflection, 1 single View instance per node. RAM: < 15 MB
• Dynamic 16-bit SISO register table with reactive hardware event dispatching
• Camera Live overlay, TikTok vertical / YouTube 90° landscape, 180° invert transform
• Clean teardown: setPreviewCallback(null) + shutdownNow() prevents SIGSEGV crashes
• Camera preview optimized at 640x480 @ 30 FPS (33ms throttle) with zero lag
• DolphinMic captures 16kHz PCM; TitanCodec compresses 4:1 with IMA-ADPCM
• TitanLiveMp4Recorder encodes hardware H.264/AAC directly to Titan-Disk
• Local micro-server on port 8080: WebSockets (/titan-live), MJPEG (/video_feed)
• On-screen IP pill (`📡 IP:Port`) + instant QR code popup for camera scanning
Current Release APK: 3.26 MB (3,420,883 Bytes) • Clean Proguard • MinSDK 24, TargetSDK 34
🗺️ TITAN UNIVERSAL 16-BIT MEMORY ZONING & NAMESPACE MAP
LOCKED: Core OS & Drivers only. Devs cannot redefine.
• `reg form:: name, email, password;` DSL allocation starts here
FREE: 4.19 Million addressable slots for custom user app state.
• Mesh cellular routing, P2P multi-device sync, high-memory tiles
DISTRIBUTED: Out-of-order reassembly & cloud relay bridge.
1. Isolation Rule: Editing JSX syntax? Touch Block 1 only. Editing .dolp bytecode? Touch Block 2 only.
2. Protocol Purity: Titan-Bus is a communication protocol, NOT a database! Never add local state caches inside the bus.
3. Single Source of Truth: Official Kotlin runtime lives in `runtime/android/`. Never modify .danphe-android directly.
4. Hard Size Limit: Release APK must remain strictly under 3.5 MB. Never introduce heavy npm/Gradle dependencies.
5. Deterministic Verification: Any change to types or codecs must pass all 29 tests in `tests/typecast_and_codec_test.js`.
Document Revision: 3.0.0 (Master AI Blueprint) • Author: Core Protocol Engineering Team • All Rights Reserved
